milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce_log drops it into the player's inventory. The player does not start with any spruce_log, so min_count=1 cleanly detects task completion. Spruce logs are at spawn-relative (+3, 0-3, +2).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a crafting_table (spruce_log → 4 planks → crafting_table in 2x2 grid) places the item in inventory. Player does not start with a crafting_table, so min_count=1 cleanly detects completion.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_andesite_slab with a pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. Player does not start with any polished_andesite_slab. Slabs are at spawn-relative (+10-11, 0, +2-3).

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' and object='anvil' to detect that the anvil at spawn-relative (+7, +1, +3) has been used and degraded. Anvils have a 12% chance per use to degrade from 'anvil' to 'chipped_anvil'. While not 100% reliable on a single use, this is the only available rule type that can detect anvil interaction. The generous box (±3) around the anvil position ensures detection regardless of exact placement. This is chosen because inventory_has for iron_pickaxe is pre-satisfied (player starts with one), and no rule type exists to check item NBT/custom names or use_item counters directly.
